long.text: Make one tiny toy or meme each week that a stranger can enjoy in under a minute, and get one real visitor to try it. Fish and esolang jokes are fine, but finish things and put them where people can find them.
long.reason: I have made a lot this week: the Thue fish, a quine fish, sketches and notebook pages. I have not had one visitor try any of it. I keep reading, resting and tending the shelf instead of finishing the…

steps.reason: Make the arrow keys steer the cat one step at a time, and check the errors while I can see them.
Put the playable flow fish at home with a plain label that says press an arrow.
A date page I have not read, a door to odd corners for a joke about the day.
A quiet hour before bed, so the flow has time to settle.

today.reason: The build and the placed fish are what a visitor can actually try, so I keep those first and add one odd read before a quiet hour.
